description: Adds the stack-agnostic execution-evidence-profile capability after observed agent sessions spent disproportionate context on duplicate instruction reads, verbose successful-command output, premature full diagnostics, monolithic diffs, and redundant visual-tool calls. The protected policy requires proportional output, progressive diagnostics, complete per-hunk review, planned manual evidence, and reuse of unchanged successful validation. The new project-owned execution profile records the stack-specific commands, log procedures, capture channels, and runtime choices without putting framework- or language-specific rules in Meridian templates.
verification: docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md carries a MERIDIAN:BEGIN capability=execution-evidence-profile v1 marker that requires project-specific output/evidence procedures while preserving required validation, independent review, and manual acceptance evidence

docs/EXECUTION_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.md is a managed, project-owned configuration surface for context reuse, concise successful validation output, failure diagnostics, per-hunk diff inspection, manual evidence, and runtime settings; it contains no framework-, language-, or tool-specific command
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, the governed-SDD operator prompts, and both governed-SDD skills direct implementation and review sessions to the project-owned profile
The protected policy requires all changed hunks to be inspected and every required validation command to run; it reduces only redundant context and output volume
